method: Curated from official EUR-Lex legal acts. Applicability remains product-specific and may depend on specifications, intended use, dates, exemptions and Member State implementation.

ppwr-2025-40.title: Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR)
ppwr-2025-40.summary: EU framework for packaging sustainability, recyclability, recycled content, labelling and packaging waste management.

sup-2019-904.title: Single-Use Plastics Directive
sup-2019-904.summary: Rules for specified single-use plastic products including beverage bottles, attached caps and recycled-content targets.

fcm-10-2011.title: Plastic food-contact materials
fcm-10-2011.summary: Composition, migration and compliance requirements for plastic materials intended to contact food.

fcm-1935-2004.title: Food-contact materials framework
fcm-1935-2004.summary: General EU framework for materials and articles intended to come into contact with food.

espr-2024-1781.title: Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR)
espr-2024-1781.summary: Horizontal ecodesign framework enabling product-specific requirements and Digital Product Passports through delegated acts.

battery-2023-1542.title: EU Batteries Regulation
battery-2023-1542.summary: Lifecycle rules for batteries including sustainability, labelling, removability, due diligence and battery passports for specified categories from 18 February 2027.

rohs-2011-65.title: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS)
rohs-2011-65.summary: Restricts specified hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment, subject to scope and exemptions.

weee-2012-19.title: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE)
weee-2012-19.summary: Collection, treatment, recovery, producer-responsibility and information requirements for electrical and electronic equipment.

red-2014-53.title: Radio Equipment Directive (RED)
red-2014-53.summary: Safety, electromagnetic compatibility, radio-spectrum and other essential requirements for radio equipment.

common-charger-2022-2380.title: Common Charger Directive
common-charger-2022-2380.summary: USB-C and charging-information requirements for covered rechargeable radio equipment; applies to laptops from 28 April 2026 and to other listed categories from 28 December 2024.

smartphone-ecodesign-2023-1670.title: Ecodesign requirements for smartphones and slate tablets
smartphone-ecodesign-2023-1670.summary: Product-specific durability, repairability, battery, software-update and resource-efficiency requirements for smartphones and specified tablets.

light-ecodesign-2019-2020.title: Ecodesign requirements for light sources
light-ecodesign-2019-2020.summary: Energy-efficiency, functional and information requirements for light sources and separate control gears.

light-energy-label-2019-2015.title: Energy labelling of light sources
light-energy-label-2019-2015.summary: Energy-label and product-information requirements for light sources.

textile-1007-2011.title: Textile fibre names and labelling
textile-1007-2011.summary: Fibre-name, composition labelling and marking requirements for textile products.

reach-1907-2006.title: REACH chemicals regulation
reach-1907-2006.summary: Horizontal EU chemicals framework including restrictions and duties concerning substances in articles.

gpsr-2023-988.title: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)
gpsr-2023-988.summary: General safety and traceability framework for consumer products where sector-specific safety law does not fully cover the relevant risk.

machinery-2006-42.title: Machinery Directive
machinery-2006-42.summary: Current machinery framework during the transition to Regulation (EU) 2023/1230.

machinery-2023-1230.title: Machinery Regulation
machinery-2023-1230.summary: New machinery framework applying from January 2027, replacing Directive 2006/42/EC subject to transitional provisions.

toy-2009-48.title: Toy Safety Directive
toy-2009-48.summary: Current toy-safety framework during the transition to Regulation (EU) 2025/2509.

toy-2025-2509.title: Toy Safety Regulation
toy-2025-2509.summary: New toy-safety regulation applying from 1 August 2030, including technical requirements for a Digital Product Passport.
